data.description:
Independent seam review (2026-08-05) of the completion-recovery chain found: in
`CompletionAgentStep._recover` (src/rebar/llm/workflow/completion_recovery.py),
the prelude `ticket = _reads.show_ticket(ticket_id, repo_root=ctx.repo_root)`
executes inside the `except LLMBudgetExhaustedError` handler but BEFORE the
`try:` whose `except LLMError` is the only place `self.failure_diagnostic` is
built. `show_ticket` raises `RebarError` (not LLMError) on a missing id or a
store that fails to reduce; that raise escapes `_recover`, `_run_leaf` flattens
it to StepResult(status="failed"), `failure_diagnostic` stays None, and
`raise_completion_workflow_failure` takes the bare-LLMError branch: no gate
error sidecar, no aggregate_* keys — the primary run's already-computed budget
and repetition diagnostic is dropped in full. Total evidence loss on a narrow
trigger.

## Plan
Move the prelude (at minimum the `show_ticket` call) inside the existing try so
a prelude failure lands in the `stage="preflight"` arm, which already prefixes
and preserves the primary diagnostic.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A `RebarError` raised by `show_ticket` during recovery produces a
      CompletionRecoveryError whose diagnostic carries the primary run's
      aggregate_* repetition/budget keys (unit test, held-out).
- [ ] The gate-error sidecar is emitted on that path.
- [ ] The happy path and the existing recovery-failure paths are unchanged
      (existing suite green).
data.title: completion recovery prelude failure drops primary diagnostic
